{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN (missing)
df['customer_age'] = df['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
df = df[~qa_mask]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
df = df[completed_mask]

# Now df contains only real, completed orders with cleaned revenue and age
print(f"Final dataset shape: {df.shape}")

# Check conversion rate by channel and segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nConversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)

# Compute difference in conversion rate: email - paid_search, within each segment
# First, pivot to get email and paid_search rates by segment
pivot = conversion_by_channel_segment.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='converted')

# Compute difference: email - paid_search
pivot['diff'] = pivot['email'] - pivot['paid_search']

print("\nWithin-segment differences (email - paid_search):")
print(pivot[['diff']])

# Compute overall difference in conversion rate by channel (raw)
raw_channel_diff = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()['email'] - df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()['paid_search']
print(f"\nRaw difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search): {raw_channel_diff:.4f}")

# Compute weighted average difference across segments
segment_counts = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].count()
total_n = segment_counts.sum()
weights = segment_counts / total_n
weighted_diff = (pivot['diff'] * weights).sum()
print(f"\nWeighted average difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_diff:.4f}")"}
